NFL DFS Projections Week 3: DraftKings Picks, Values and Sim Plays

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, September 27 · 13 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 26, 10:31 AM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection on the Week 3 DraftKings main slate: 31.4 DraftKings points at $8,800. He also holds 38% of the simulated winning-lineup credit across 10,000 simulations, more than any other player on the slate, with Kenneth Walker III second at 29% for $7,400.

Behind Gibbs, the model's next four projections are Kenneth Walker III (24.5, $7,400), Josh Allen (23.1, $8,000), Christian McCaffrey (22.9, $8,300) and Amon-Ra St. Brown (22.4, $7,900). Jahmyr Gibbs returns the most per dollar of that group at 3.56 projected points per $1,000. Amon-Ra St. Brown leads the wide receivers at 22.4 for $7,900, Josh Allen leads the quarterbacks at 23.1 for $8,000, and Trey McBride leads the tight ends at 19.3 for $6,700.

The 13-game slate runs from a 53.5-point total in BAL at DAL down to 37.5 in TEN at NYG. Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 26, 10:31 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup credit comes from 10,000 simulations of the contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th.

Quarterbacks: Week 3 DraftKings projections

Josh Allen, BUF vs LAC ($8,000)

Josh Allen carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 23.1 DraftKings points at $8,000, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 2.9 points clear of Lamar Jackson. The model includes 6.5 rushing attempts. The current projection of 23.1 compares with a saved model baseline of 21.0. The salary works out to 2.89 projected points per $1,000, 13th of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 23.2 points with a simulated floor of 8.5 and a ceiling of 42.1, and he holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 7-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 28.75 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Lamar Jackson, BAL at DAL ($7,500)

Lamar Jackson projects 2nd at the position with 20.2 DraftKings points at $7,500. The model includes 4.4 rushing attempts. The current projection of 20.2 compares with a saved model baseline of 18.9. The salary works out to 2.70 projected points per $1,000, 18th of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Jackson averaged 20.5 points with a simulated floor of 8.1 and a ceiling of 37.5, and he holds 4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Baltimore is a 3.5-point favorite on the road against Dallas, with an implied team total of 28.5 in a game totaled at 53.5.

Value: Deshaun Watson, CLE vs CAR ($4,700)

Deshaun Watson projects for 18.6 DraftKings points at $4,700, which works out to 3.95 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 19 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 7.5 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Watson averaged 18.5 points with a simulated floor of 6.8 and a ceiling of 33.9, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cleveland is a 2.5-point underdog at home against Carolina, with an implied team total of 20 in a game totaled at 42.5.
